AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT * FROM items WHERE true
AND (business_date,business_time,created_at,id) < (#{p.cursorDate},#{p.cursorTime},#{p.cursorCreated},#{p.cursorId})
ORDER BY business_date DESC,business_time DESC,created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{p.limit} ), adjustment_totals AS ( SELECT a.original_expense_id,sum(a.amount) AS effective_total FROM expense_adjustment a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT source_expense_id FROM page WHERE source_expense_id IS NOT NULL) selected ON selected.source_expense_id=a.original_expense_id WHERE a.status='EFFECTIVE' GROUP BY a.original_expense_id ) SELECT p.id,p.entry_type,p.business_time,p.business_date,p.created_at,p.title,p.category_name,p.counterparty_name, p.funding_channel_name_snapshot,p.amount,p.note,p.adjustment_type,p.original_expense_id, CASE WHEN p.source_expense_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(t.effective_total,0) END AS effective_adjustment_amount, CASE WHEN p.source_expense_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.source_paid_amount-COALESCE(t.effective_total,0) END AS net_expense_amount, p.source_expense_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(t.effective_total,0)=p.source_paid_amount AS fully_adjusted, p.version,p.lifecycle_status,p.deleted_at,p.purge_after,p.remaining_days,p.linked_count FROM page p LEFT JOIN adjustment_totals t ON t.original_expense_id=p.source_expense_id ORDER BY p.business_date DESC,p.business_time DESC,p.created_at DESC,p.id DESC
